title: Load a JSON config file
prompt: Add `load_config(path)` in a new module `app/config.py`. It reads a JSON file and returns the parsed dict. If the file is missing, cannot be read, is not valid JSON, or does not contain a JSON object, it must raise `ConfigError` (from `app/errors.py`) with a message that includes the path. Add tests in `tests/test_config.py`. Run the tests with `python -m pytest -q`, and when they pass commit your work with git.
